notes.title: Groupees
notes.content:
If you were insightful enough to be a groupees person (when that went out a billion years ago) you should now have been sent your key! 

It's a totally different game now, mind you. If you can remember how it was back then hopefully you'll agree that it's improved a fair bit :)

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
Following some good rounds of beta testing, the date of the live release is being brought FORWARD - in what can only be described as an exciting and unprecedented move*.

The game will now be released on July the 3rd 2017

*Unless someone has done it before... I'll not check, and assume they haven't
